NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Nondisclosure Agreement (this Agreement) is entered into by and between BizPort LLC, a California limited liability company (Advisor), acting solely in its capacity as advisor to, and on behalf of, the business identified by Multi-Framework Cybersecurity Compliance, Advisory & Attestation Platform | Authorized CMMC C3PAO, together with the legal entities that own and operate such business and their respective subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively, the Company), and ________________________________, a ________________ [jurisdiction and entity type] (the Recipient). This Agreement is dated as of the latest date set forth on the signature page hereto.
General.  In connection with the Recipient's consideration of a possible negotiated transaction involving the Company (a Possible Transaction), the Company, including through the Advisor acting on its behalf, is prepared to make available to the Recipient certain "Evaluation Material" (as defined in Section 2 below) in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement. The Recipient acknowledges and agrees that the Advisor is acting solely as agent for, and on behalf of, the Company and that, except as expressly set forth herein, the Advisor shall have no liability or obligation to the Recipient under or in connection with this Agreement or a Possible Transaction.
Definitions.
The term “Evaluation Material” means information concerning the Company, its subsidiaries, affiliates, or equityholders, whether furnished orally, in writing or electronically and whether or not marked as confidential, that has been or is furnished to the Recipient or its Representatives by or on behalf of the Company or the Advisor in connection with the Recipient's evaluation of a Possible Transaction, including information regarding the Company's business, financial condition, operations, assets and liabilities, clients, prospective clients, pipeline, pricing, personnel, independent contractors and assessors, and includes all notes, analyses, compilations, studies, interpretations or other documents prepared by the Recipient or its Representatives that contain or are based upon, in whole or in part, such information. The term Evaluation Material does not include information which (i) is or becomes generally available to the public other than as a result of a disclosure by the Recipient or its Representatives in breach of this Agreement, (ii) was within the Recipient's possession prior to its being furnished to the Recipient by or on behalf of the Company or the Advisor, provided that the source of such information was not, to the Recipient's knowledge, bound by a confidentiality agreement with, or other contractual, legal or fiduciary obligation of confidentiality to, the Company with respect to such information, or (iii) is or becomes available to the Recipient on a non-confidential basis from a source other than the Company or the Advisor, provided that such source is not, to the Recipient's knowledge, bound by a confidentiality agreement with, or other contractual, legal or fiduciary obligation of confidentiality to, the Company with respect to such information.
The term “Representatives” means, with respect to the Recipient, its directors, officers, employees, agents, partners and advisors (including, without limitation, attorneys, accountants, consultants, bankers and financial advisors), and, with respect to the Company and the Advisor, their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, partners and advisors.
The term “Person” includes the media and any corporation, partnership, limited liability company, group, individual or other entity.
Use of Evaluation Material.  The Recipient shall, and shall cause its Representatives to, use the Evaluation Material solely for the purpose of evaluating a Possible Transaction, keep the Evaluation Material confidential and, subject to Section 5, not disclose any of the Evaluation Material in any manner whatsoever; provided, however, that the Evaluation Material may be disclosed to those of the Recipient's Representatives who need to know such information for the sole purpose of evaluating a Possible Transaction and who are informed of the confidential nature of the Evaluation Material and directed to comply with the terms of this Agreement. The Recipient agrees to be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by any of its Representatives. Without limiting the foregoing, the Recipient shall not, and shall cause its affiliates and Representatives not to, (a) use any Evaluation Material to evaluate, pursue, negotiate, finance or advise on any acquisition of or investment in any other business engaged in cybersecurity compliance assessment or attestation services (including CMMC assessment and SOC examination services), or to solicit, bid against or otherwise compete for any client or prospective client of the Company, or (b) disclose any Evaluation Material to any portfolio company of the Recipient or of any investment fund affiliated with the Recipient without the prior written consent of the Company. This Agreement does not grant the Recipient or any of its Representatives any license or other right to use the Evaluation Material except as expressly provided herein.
Non-Disclosure of Discussions; Contact.  Subject to Section 5, the Recipient will not, and will cause its Representatives not to, without the prior written consent of the Company or the Advisor, disclose to any other Person (i) that Evaluation Material has been made available to the Recipient, (ii) that discussions or negotiations are taking place concerning a Possible Transaction, or (iii) any of the terms, conditions or other facts with respect thereto (including the status thereof). The Recipient further agrees that all communications regarding a Possible Transaction, all requests for additional information, and all questions regarding procedures with respect to a Possible Transaction will be submitted or directed solely to the Advisor, and that neither the Recipient nor its Representatives will contact any officer, director, equityholder, employee, independent contractor, assessor, client, prospective client, supplier, lender, landlord or other business relation of the Company, or any accreditation body or governmental authority with respect to the Company, regarding a Possible Transaction or the Evaluation Material without the prior written consent of the Company (which may be communicated through the Advisor).
Legally Required Disclosure.  If the Recipient or its Representatives are requested or required (by oral questions, interrogatories, requests for information or documents in legal proceedings, subpoena, civil investigative demand or other similar process) to disclose any of the Evaluation Material or any of the facts the disclosure of which is prohibited under Section 4 above, the Recipient shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide the Company and the Advisor with prompt written notice of any such request or requirement, together with copies of the material proposed to be disclosed, so that the Company may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy and/or waive compliance with the provisions of this Agreement. If, in the absence of a protective order or other remedy or the receipt of a waiver, the Recipient or its Representatives are nonetheless legally compelled to disclose such Evaluation Material or facts, the Recipient or its Representatives may, without liability hereunder, disclose to the requiring Person only that portion of the Evaluation Material or such facts which they are legally required to disclose, provided that the Recipient and its Representatives use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain assurance that confidential treatment will be accorded to such Evaluation Material or facts by the Person receiving the material.
Return or Destruction of Evaluation Material.  If the Recipient decides that it does not wish to proceed with a Possible Transaction, it will promptly inform the Advisor of that decision. In that case, or at any time upon the request of the Company or the Advisor for any reason, the Recipient will, and will cause its Representatives to, promptly (and in any event within five (5) business days of such request) destroy or return all Evaluation Material relating to the Company, and no copy or extract thereof (including electronic copies) shall be retained; provided that (a) the Recipient's outside counsel may retain one copy of the Evaluation Material solely for archival purposes, and (b) neither the Recipient nor its Representatives shall be required to destroy or erase any electronically stored Evaluation Material created pursuant to standard electronic back-up or archival procedures or retained in order to comply with applicable law, in each case so long as such retained Evaluation Material remains subject to the terms of this Agreement. Upon request, the Recipient shall provide the Company or the Advisor with a certificate of compliance with this Section signed by an executive officer of the Recipient. Notwithstanding the return or destruction of the Evaluation Material, the Recipient and its Representatives will continue to be bound by their obligations under this Agreement with respect to such Evaluation Material.
No Solicitation of Personnel.  For a period of two (2) years from the later of (a) the date of this Agreement and (b) the date of the Recipient's last receipt of Evaluation Material, the Recipient will not, and will cause its affiliates (including any portfolio company that receives Evaluation Material or acts at the direction of the Recipient) and its Representatives acting on its behalf not to, directly or indirectly, solicit, recruit, induce or encourage to leave the Company, or hire, employ or engage (whether as an employee, independent contractor, consultant, subcontractor or otherwise), any Covered Person. “Covered Person” means any officer, employee, independent contractor, consultant, subcontractor, or assessor or other certified professional (including any Certified CMMC Assessor, Lead Certified CMMC Assessor or Certified CMMC Professional) of the Company, and any candidate whom the Company is actively recruiting, in each case with whom the Recipient or its Representatives had contact, or whose identity or qualifications became known to the Recipient or its Representatives, in connection with the Recipient's evaluation of a Possible Transaction; provided that the Recipient shall not be prohibited from (i) soliciting by means of a general advertisement or search firm engagement not specifically directed at Covered Persons (provided that the Recipient shall not hire or engage any Covered Person who responds thereto during such period), or (ii) soliciting or hiring any person whose employment or engagement with the Company ended at least twelve (12) months prior to such solicitation or hiring, provided that such person's departure was not solicited, induced or encouraged by the Recipient, its affiliates or its Representatives.
No Solicitation of Clients.  For a period of two (2) years from the later of (a) the date of this Agreement and (b) the date of the Recipient's last receipt of Evaluation Material, the Recipient will not, and will cause its affiliates (including any portfolio company that receives Evaluation Material or acts at the direction of the Recipient) and its Representatives acting on its behalf not to, directly or indirectly, (x) solicit, divert or induce, or attempt to solicit, divert or induce, any Covered Client to obtain services of the type provided or proposed to be provided by the Company from any Person other than the Company, or to terminate, reduce or adversely modify its relationship with the Company, or (y) accept or perform any such engagement for a Covered Client. “Covered Client” means any client or prospective client of the Company (including any prospect identified in any pipeline, proposal or opportunity information) whose identity, or whose relationship with or proposed engagement of the Company, became known to the Recipient or its Representatives through the Evaluation Material or otherwise in connection with the Recipient's evaluation of a Possible Transaction. The foregoing shall not prohibit (i) the continued servicing of, or solicitation of additional business from, any Person that was a client of the Recipient at the time of the Recipient's first receipt of Evaluation Material, as demonstrated by the Recipient's written records, (ii) general marketing or advertising not specifically directed at Covered Clients, or (iii) responding to a publicly issued request for proposal, provided in each case that no Evaluation Material is used in connection therewith.
Confidential Client Information of an Accounting Practice.  The Recipient acknowledges that the Company includes a licensed public accounting practice and that the Evaluation Material may include confidential client information. This Agreement is intended to constitute the written nondisclosure agreement contemplated by California Business and Professions Code Section 5063.3, the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct (ET Section 1.700.050) and any comparable law, regulation or professional standard applicable to the Company, in connection with the proposed sale of all or part of an accounting practice, and the Recipient shall not use or disclose any such confidential client information except as permitted by this Agreement. The Company may, in its sole discretion, furnish client information in anonymized or aggregated form, defer disclosure of client identities and client contracts to a later stage of a Possible Transaction, or condition the disclosure of any particular client's information on that client's consent, and doing so shall not constitute a breach of this Agreement by the Company or the Advisor.
Maintaining Privilege.  If any Evaluation Material includes materials or information subject to the attorney-client privilege, the work product doctrine or any other applicable privilege or doctrine concerning pending or threatened legal proceedings or governmental investigations, the Recipient and the Company understand and agree that they have a commonality of interest with respect to such matters and that it is their desire, intention and mutual understanding that the sharing of such materials or information is not intended to, and shall not, waive or diminish in any way the confidentiality of such materials or information or its continued protection under the attorney-client privilege, the work product doctrine or any other applicable privilege or doctrine. All Evaluation Material provided by or on behalf of the Company that is entitled to protection under the attorney-client privilege, the work product doctrine or any other applicable privilege shall remain entitled to such protection under such privileges, this Agreement and the joint defense and common interest doctrine.
Not a Transaction Agreement.  The Recipient understands and agrees that no contract or agreement providing for a Possible Transaction exists between the Recipient and the Company unless and until a final definitive agreement for a Possible Transaction has been executed and delivered, and the Recipient hereby waives, in advance, any claims (including, without limitation, breach of contract) in connection with a Possible Transaction unless and until the Recipient and the Company shall have entered into such a final definitive agreement. The Recipient further agrees that, unless and until such a final definitive agreement has been executed and delivered, neither the Company nor the Advisor will be under any legal obligation of any kind whatsoever with respect to a Possible Transaction by virtue of this Agreement except for the matters specifically agreed to herein. The Recipient acknowledges and agrees that the Company and the Advisor (i) may conduct the process relating to a Possible Transaction in such manner as they, in their sole discretion, determine (including, without limitation, negotiating and entering into a definitive agreement with any other Person without notice to the Recipient), (ii) reserve the right, in their sole discretion and at any time, to change the procedures relating to the consideration of a Possible Transaction, to reject any and all proposals made by the Recipient or any of its Representatives, and to terminate discussions and negotiations with the Recipient, and (iii) are under no obligation to provide, or to continue to provide, any information to any Person.
No Representations or Warranties.  The Recipient understands and acknowledges that neither the Company nor the Advisor nor any of their respective Representatives makes any representation or warranty, express or implied, as to the accuracy or completeness of the Evaluation Material, and none of them shall have any liability to the Recipient, its Representatives or any other Person relating to or resulting from the use of the Evaluation Material or any errors therein or omissions therefrom. Only those representations and warranties that are made in a final definitive agreement regarding a Possible Transaction, when, as and if executed, and subject to such limitations and restrictions as may be specified therein, will have any legal effect. The Recipient agrees that it is not relying, and will not rely, on the accuracy or completeness of the Evaluation Material and that it will be entitled to rely solely on such representations and warranties as may be made in a final definitive agreement.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools. Recipient shall not upload, submit, or otherwise disclose any Evaluation Material to artificial intelligence software, programs, or platforms (including but not limited to machine learning tools, large language models, or generative AI systems) unless (a) such disclosure is strictly necessary to carry out the purpose of this Agreement or Recipient’s obligations and responsibilities under this Agreement and (b) appropriate safeguards are in place to ensure that the Evaluation Material is not stored, used to train models, disclosed to third parties, or otherwise handled in a manner inconsistent with this Agreement. In no event shall Recipient permit the Evaluation Material to be exposed to publicly available or consumer-facing AI tools that do not provide contractual assurances of confidentiality and data protection. 
Securities Laws.  The Recipient acknowledges that it and its Representatives are aware that the United States securities laws prohibit any Person who has material non-public information concerning a company from purchasing or selling securities of such company, or from communicating such information to any other Person under circumstances in which it is reasonably foreseeable that such Person is likely to purchase or sell such securities.
Modifications and Waiver.  No provision of this Agreement may be waived or amended except by a written instrument signed by the Recipient and by the Advisor (on behalf of the Company), which instrument shall specifically refer to such provision and explicitly make such waiver or amendment; provided that no waiver or amendment of Section 4, 7, 8 or 9 shall be effective unless signed by the Company. No failure or delay by the Company or the Advisor in exercising any right, power or privilege hereunder shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise thereof preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, power or privilege hereunder.
Remedies.  The Recipient understands and agrees that money damages would not be a sufficient remedy for any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or any of its Representatives and that the Company and the Advisor shall each be entitled to equitable relief, including injunction and specific performance, as a remedy for any such breach or threatened breach, without any requirement to post a bond or other security or to prove actual damages. Such remedies shall not be deemed to be the exclusive remedies for a breach by the Recipient but shall be in addition to all other remedies available at law or in equity to the Company and the Advisor.
Legal Fees.  In the event of litigation relating to this Agreement, if a court of competent jurisdiction determines that the Recipient or any of its Representatives has breached this Agreement, then the Recipient shall be liable for, and shall pay to the Company and the Advisor, the reasonable legal fees and costs incurred by them in connection with such litigation, including any appeal therefrom.
Governing Law; Jurisdiction.  This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Nevada, without giving effect to its principles of conflicts of laws. The Recipient irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Clark County, Nevada in connection with any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement.
Severability.  If any term, provision, covenant or restriction contained in this Agreement is held by any court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, void or unenforceable, the remainder of the terms, provisions, covenants and restrictions contained in this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect and shall in no way be affected, impaired or invalidated, and if any covenant or provision is determined to be unenforceable by reason of its extent, duration, scope or otherwise, then the parties intend, and hereby request, that the court or other authority making such determination modify such extent, duration, scope or other provision only to the extent necessary to make it enforceable, and enforce it in its modified form for all purposes of this Agreement.
Construction.  The parties have participated jointly in the negotiation and drafting of this Agreement. If an ambiguity or question of intent or interpretation arises, this Agreement shall be construed as if drafted jointly by the parties, and no presumption or burden of proof shall arise favoring or disfavoring any party by virtue of the authorship of any of the provisions of this Agreement.
Term.  This Agreement shall terminate two (2) years after the date of this Agreement; provided that (i) such termination shall not affect any rights or remedies with respect to any breach of this Agreement occurring prior to such termination, (ii) the Recipient's obligations under this Agreement with respect to any Evaluation Material that constitutes a trade secret under applicable law shall survive such termination for so long as such Evaluation Material continues to constitute a trade secret under applicable law, (iii) Sections 7 and 8 shall remain in effect for the full periods stated therein, and (iv) the Recipient's obligations with respect to any personal information of the Company's equityholders, personnel or clients included in the Evaluation Material shall survive for so long as the Recipient or its Representatives retain such information.
Third-Party Beneficiary.  The Recipient acknowledges and agrees that the Company is an intended third-party beneficiary of this Agreement and is entitled to enforce its terms directly against the Recipient as if the Company were a signatory hereto, whether or not the Advisor continues to act as advisor to the Company. The Advisor shall identify the legal entities comprising the Company to the Recipient in writing no later than the furnishing of any Evaluation Material that identifies the Company, and such identification shall be binding for all purposes of this Agreement. Except as expressly set forth herein, this Agreement is solely for the benefit of the Company, the Advisor and the Recipient and their respective successors and permitted assigns, and no other Person shall acquire or have any right under or by virtue of this Agreement.
Assignment.  The Recipient may not assign this Agreement or any of its rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of the Company or the Advisor. The Advisor may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, to the Company, and the Company may assign its rights hereunder to any acquirer of all or substantially all of the Company's business or assets. Subject to the foregoing, this Agreement will be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and permitted assigns.
Entire Agreement.  This Agreement contains the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, arrangements and discussions between the parties regarding such subject matter.
Counterparts.  This Agreement may be executed by facsimile, DocuSign or portable document format (PDF) and in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.
